liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Reviewer is amazed that Morning Dew emerges from Space, in a second set that also has Help>Slip>Franklin's and Terrapin; Morning Dew emerges from Space like a benediction, per the reviewer [13][23]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): Brent's keyboard work at the start of Help is singled out as classic [13]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Reviewer especially loves this Franklin's Tower [15]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry sounds awesome on Terrapin Station [20]
- **Touch Of Grey** (1 review): First set has songs from the upcoming album In the Dark, which sound a bit studio-tight [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-04-01.nak304.mikeg-suraci.79458.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 147 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1984-04-01.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.105822.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 154 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [3]
- **gd1984-04-01.176251.senn421.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 153 min [4]
- **gd1984-04-01.fob.sonyECM220t.kirschner.miller.95693.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 154 min; rated 4.73/5 by 11 [6]
- **gd1984-04-01.sonyecm.andrewf.30828.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 154 min [8]. Said about its sound: A faulty mic cord caused left-channel dropouts, patched from the right channel in Drums and Good Lovin' [8]
- **gd84-04-01.sbd.serafin.7366.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 151 min; rated 4.27/5 by 22 [11]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says it was one of the first really good-sounding tapes they owned; Jerry's playing is fluid, sleepy; Source sounds great overall, but a download had cuts in Help>Slip>Franklin's and digital glitches in Dew's quiet part; the hissy cassette copy lacks them; There is a cut or fade-out between Drums and Morning Dew that the reviewer wants fixed [13][15][16][18][20]

## Around the show

- Attendee, aged 16, says the room felt intimate; a neighbor called every second-set song, and smoke seemed to rise from Jerry's guitar [19]
- Reviewer calls it a great hometown gig [23]
- Reviewer ranks the second set alongside 8-10-82 among favorites of the early 1980s [15]
- Reviewer says it far exceeds anything else from 1984 and calls it the 80s equivalent of Barton Hall [24]
- Reviewer says the 31st was a good warm-up to this night [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-04-01.nak304.mikeg-suraci.79458.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Mike G. and Tony Suraci; transferred by Tony Suraci; source: Nakamichi CM304's>Sony D5M>Sony D5M Location: At SBD/Stand at 7 Feet [1]
- **gd1984-04-01.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.105822.flac16**: taped by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Cassette (Sony D5/Maxell XLIIS-90) [3]
- **gd1984-04-01.176251.senn421.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bill Bradt; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bill Bradt's Master Audience Cassettes: Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5M (TDK MA90) [4]. Also: Master cassettes came from Bill and Kathy Weir Bradt; Charlie Miller transferred and coordinated the effort; Sony ECM220t and Nakamichi 304 sources were combined to supply an 11:22 patch in Drums; pitch verified [4]
- **gd1984-04-01.fob.sonyECM220t.kirschner.miller.95693.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Michael Kirschner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B) [6]. Also: Sony ECM220t source via Nakamichi 300/CP4 to cassette master, lent by Michael Kirschner; a cassette master patches Good Lovin' gaps [6]
- **gd1984-04-01.sonyecm.andrewf.30828.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F.; source: Sony ECM-939LT stereo mics (x2) > Marantz PMD-340 cassette deck (Dolby On) > MAC > Sony TC-D5M > Soundblaster > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC [8]. Also: Sony ECM audience recording on cassette, with the tape flip at the split between discs 2 and 3 [8]
- **gd84-04-01.sbd.serafin.7366.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [11]. Also: Reviewer's early cassette copy had unlabeled filler after the show, possibly Desolation Row>Queen Jane or Peggy-O [21]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steven Rood Grateful Dead: [1984-04-01 Marin County Veterans Auditorium, San Rafael, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-04-01-marin-county-veterans-auditorium-san-rafael-ca-usa/) [26]
- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-03-31 Marin County Veterans Auditorium, San Rafael, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-03-31-marin-county-veterans-auditorium-san-rafael-ca-usa/) [27]
- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-03-29 Marin County Veterans Auditorium, San Rafael, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-03-29-marin-county-veterans-auditorium-san-rafael-ca-usa/) [28]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead GD Laminate, Marin Veterans Auditorium](https://www.dead.net/archives/1984/clippings/gd-laminate-marin-veterans-auditorium) [29]
